capabilities: pin the current file via a star button in the header bar
render pinned files as a tile grid above the file tree
drag and drop tiles to reorder them
unpin or open tiles from a right-click context menu
toggle pins with a bindable command or hotkey
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile. Repository README notes the manual-install folder must be named star-pins.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no built-in way to keep a small set of frequently used notes visible and one click away at the top of the tree.

relations.evidence: if you use the Iconize plugin, each tile shows the icon you assigned to that file

summary: File explorer enhancer that pins starred notes as Arc-style, draggable tiles above the file tree, with a header star button and hotkey command.
